Res.Caption: Last Transfer Date (UTC)
Res.FullDescription: The date/time in UTC that this workflow was last transferred into a Buffer Management system component.

Res.Caption: Last Transfer Time
Res.FullDescription: The date/time that this workflow was last transferred into a Buffer Management system component.

Res.Caption: Current Component
Res.FullDescription: The component of the Buffer Management System that this workflow is currently at.

Res.Caption: System
Res.FullDescription: The Buffer Management System of the component that this workflow is currently at.

Res.Caption: Branch
Res.FullDescription: The branch related to the workflow (when set the latest acceptable release date and buffer penetration will be calculated taking the branch's holidays into account).

Res.Caption: Department
Res.FullDescription: The department related to the workflow (when set the latest acceptable release date and buffer penetration will be calculated based on the department working hours).

Res.Caption: Agreed Delivery Date (UTC)
Res.FullDescription: The agreed delivery date of this workflow in UTC.

Res.Caption: Date Acceptability
Res.FullDescription: Indicates the level of hardness and softness for late or early delivery.

Res.Caption: Deadline Type
Res.FullDescription: Indicates whether the deadline is a soft deadline or a hard deadline.

Res.Caption: Earliest Start Date (UTC)
Res.FullDescription: The date in UTC prior to which work should not commence on this workflow.

Res.Caption: Effective Agreed Delivery Date (UTC)
Res.FullDescription: The agreed delivery date of this workflow if set or otherwise of its job workflow in UTC.

Res.Caption: Release Sequence Sort Date (UTC)
Res.FullDescription: The date in UTC based on Earliest Start Date or Last Transfer Date of the workflow/its job header and used by Release Gate to order workflows with the same Effective Nudge.

Res.Caption: Latest Acceptable Release Date (UTC)
Res.FullDescription: The date in UTC based on Agreed Delivery Date, workflow duration and buffer size to represent the latest acceptable date when this workflow should be released to be completed in time.

Res.Caption: Latest Acceptable Release Date (UTC)
Res.FullDescription: The date in UTC based on Agreed Delivery Date, workflow duration and buffer size to represent the latest acceptable date when this workflow should be released to be completed in time.

Res.Caption: Release Group
Res.FullDescription: The group whose release rule setting overrides (if any) will be used when evaluating transfer rules. System-wide release rule settings are used when no Release Group is specified.

Res.Caption: Completion Milestone
Res.FullDescription: The workflow will be closed when the milestones with a matching key are completed.

Res.Caption: Release Delay Factor
Res.FullDescription: The number of times to multiply (factor) the sum of the estimates of previous workflows that need to be elapsed when determining a workflow's Staggered Release Delay Expiry.

Res.Caption: Release Delay Time
Res.FullDescription: The number of hours/minutes from release of previous workflows that need to be elapsed when determining a workflow’s Staggered Release Delay Expiry.

Res.Caption: Auto Assign Tasks
Res.FullDescription: Allow tasks requiring capabilities with no resource assigned to be automatically assigned when released to a buffer, or after aging inside a buffer for the configured amount of time.

Res.Caption: Critical Handover
Res.FullDescription: Specifies whether the handover between resources on this workflow or job is critical, causing emphasis on Visual Boards.

Res.Caption: Standby Task
Res.FullDescription: Specifies whether resources should work on this workflow outside a buffer during standby time.

Res.Caption: Approved
Res.FullDescription: Specifies whether this workflow has been approved for working.

Res.Caption: Buffer Timespan Name
Res.FullDescription: The maximum intended time for this workflow to spend in a buffer once the workflow is released. The time span defined on a workflow overrides the time span defined on the buffer it is released to.

Res.Caption: Effective Buffer Duration
Res.FullDescription: The calculated duration a workflow will spend in a buffer based on priority rules. Uses the workflow's buffer timespan if set, otherwise falls back to the job level workflow's timespan, or finally the dedicated buffer's timespan.

Res.Caption: Status
Res.FullDescription: The completeness and start-ability status of this workflow.

Res.Caption: Nudge
Res.FullDescription: The nudge up or down applied to this workflow. Nudge affects the position of this workflow in release sequence.

Res.Caption: Persistent Effective Nudge
Res.FullDescription: The nudge value used for sorting items inside the Release Gate. It considers the nudge applied to this workflow as well as nudges of applied tags.

Res.Caption: Agreed Delivery Date Defaults From
Res.FullDescription: Specify the date/time information source which the system will use to populate the Agreed Delivery Date of this workflow.

Res.Caption: Agreed Delivery Date Default Hours Offset
Res.FullDescription: Specify the amount of time before or after the selected date/time information source which the Agreed Delivery Date should be set to.

Res.Caption: Earliest Start Date Defaults From
Res.FullDescription: Specify the date/time information source which the system will use to populate the Earliest Start Date of this workflow.

Res.Caption: Earliest Start Date Default Hours Offset
Res.FullDescription: Specify the amount of time before or after the selected date/time information source which the Earliest Start Date should be set to.
